item.title: How black artists helped shape the sound of Las Vegas
item.description: Las Vegas has always loved the spotlight — but long before residencies became blockbuster events, Black artists were already shaping the city’s sound, often without getting full access to the very resorts they helped fill.

item.title: Las Vegas named the best place in America to get married
item.description: Las Vegas has always been synonymous with weddings, especially if you want an Elvis lookalike to perform the ceremony. Well, now it's officially the best place in the country to get married.

item.title: Nevada judge releases property manager tied to Las Vegas bio lab
item.description: A federal judge ordered the release Friday of the property manager connected to a suspected Las Vegas bio lab, who prosecutors charged with unlawfully possessing guns.

item.title: Las Vegas law firm donates $80K to Las Vegas nonprofit
item.description: Claggett & Sykes Trial Lawyers donated $80,000 to The Just One Project, a Las Vegas nonprofit that helps connect people with food and other essential resources, to support its Monthly Food as Medicine Farmers Markets.

item.title: Las Vegas police mourn loss of long‑serving K9

item.title: More U.S Workers are picking up 'secondary incomes'
item.description: 72% of U.S workers are relying on secondary incomes, according to resume and career-building website myperfectresume.com.
